verdict.rationale: uv is a local CLI with no hosted user-data service, so the only retained data in evidence is its local dependency cache. Users can delete that cache entirely or per package with `uv cache clean` [uv-docs-11, uv-docs-49]. In CI, cache persistence is optional via setup-uv [uv-docs-10]. Ephemeral tool environments via `uvx` avoid persistent installs [uv-docs-7]. Missing for 10: any documented retention policy or automatic expiry/pruning controls, any statement on telemetry or what data (if any) leaves the machine, and independent corroboration of deletion behavior.
